changes.title: Palette art
items: The art takes much less graphics memory: every sprite is stored as palette colours, drawn exactly as before

changes.title: Beat follows music
items: After a hitch, the dancefloor and everything else on the beat stay in time with the music

changes.title: Music ahead
items: The music is drawn a few seconds ahead, so it plays on through the game's hitches instead of cutting out (add ?music=live to hear the old way)
